title: Ender Lens [Picture Mode Addon]
description: An addon for Picture Mode on NeoForge 1.21.1 that replaces button access with an Ender Lens block.
body:
**Ender Lens [Picture Mode Addon]** is an addon for **Picture Mode** on **NeoForge 1.21.1**.

It removes the need to use the default Picture Mode button by adding a new block called **Ender Lens**.  
Use the block to open Picture Mode directly in-game.

### Requires
- **Picture Mode** by **Icanttellyou**

### Credit
Full credit for the original Picture Mode mod goes to **Icanttellyou**.  
This project is only an addon built to work alongside it.

Original mod: https://modrinth.com/mod/picture-mode
